name: server_info
description: Report this server's version, the pinned Godot versions it targets (4.4, 4.5), and which correctness pillars (GDScript lint, API symbols, scene/resource analysis) are currently available. Takes no arguments.

name: api_symbol_lookup
description: Look up a Godot API symbol (class, method, property, or signal) by name across the pinned Godot versions. Supports 'Owner.member' queries. Returns full signature data, or closest-match suggestions on a miss.

version.description: Limit to one version; omit to search all available versions

kind.description: Restrict results to one symbol kind

name: api_class_summary
description: Full member listing for one Godot class in one version: inheritance chain, methods, properties, signals, enums, and constants.

name: api_diff
description: Diff a Godot class or symbol between two versions (default 4.4 -> 4.5): what was added, removed, or had its signature changed, with old and new signatures side by side.

name: lint_file
description: Lint a single GDScript (.gd) file against the default ruleset. 'path' is required; pass 'source' to lint unsaved text instead of reading the file. Config is loaded from the nearest ancestor directory containing godot-correctness.config.json or project.godot (the project root), the same config lint_project uses. Returns a findings array.

path.description: Path to the .gd file (used for the reported location and config lookup)

source.description: Inline GDScript source; if omitted, the file at 'path' is read

name: lint_project
description: Lint every GDScript file under a project root, honoring include/exclude globs from godot-correctness.config.json. Returns aggregated findings and severity counts, and the Godot version project.godot declares. Pass 'baseline' to see only new findings.

path.description: Path to the Godot project root

baseline.description: Optional gdcorrect baseline file (from 'gdcorrect <cmd> --write-baseline'); relative paths resolve against the project root. When set, only findings not in the baseline are returned, plus 'baselined' and 'staleBaselineEntries' counts.

name: list_rules
description: List every rule gdcorrect can report (GDScript lint rules and the scene, project, and registry checks) with its description and default severity. Pass 'path' (a project root) to also get the effective enabled/severity/options from that project's godot-correctness.config.json and the Godot version project.godot declares.

path.description: Optional Godot project root to resolve its config

name: validate_scenes
description: Validate every .tscn under a project root: ext_resource paths resolve, ExtResource/SubResource references are declared, there are no duplicate resource ids, node parent paths exist, [connection] targets have the named method, and literal $Path/get_node() paths in attached scripts exist in the scene.

path.description: Path to the Godot project root

baseline.description: Optional gdcorrect baseline file (from 'gdcorrect <cmd> --write-baseline'); relative paths resolve against the project root. When set, only findings not in the baseline are returned, plus 'baselined' and 'staleBaselineEntries' counts.

name: validate_project_config
description: Validate project.godot: the main scene exists, autoload paths exist, input actions are well-formed, and input action names used in scripts are defined.

path.description: Path to the Godot project root

baseline.description: Optional gdcorrect baseline file (from 'gdcorrect <cmd> --write-baseline'); relative paths resolve against the project root. When set, only findings not in the baseline are returned, plus 'baselined' and 'staleBaselineEntries' counts.

name: validate_registries
description: Deep-validate data-driven .tres registries in the configured registryDirs: each parses, its script resolves (recording class_name), and every resource-path property points at an existing file (the dangling-path check).

path.description: Path to the Godot project root

baseline.description: Optional gdcorrect baseline file (from 'gdcorrect <cmd> --write-baseline'); relative paths resolve against the project root. When set, only findings not in the baseline are returned, plus 'baselined' and 'staleBaselineEntries' counts.

name: project_report
description: Aggregate all static checks (scenes, project config, registries, and GDScript lint) into one report with severity counts.

path.description: Path to the Godot project root

baseline.description: Optional gdcorrect baseline file (from 'gdcorrect <cmd> --write-baseline'); relative paths resolve against the project root. When set, only findings not in the baseline are returned, plus 'baselined' and 'staleBaselineEntries' counts.
